body: app/cli.py prints only the human report from app/report.py; there is no way for scripts to consume it. Add a --json flag: `python3 -m app.cli --json` emits the same report data (service, status, and the checks list with name/ok/latency_ms, inferred from the REPORT dict in app/report.py) as a single JSON document on stdout. Human output stays the default when --json is absent, unchanged. Acceptance: --json output parses as JSON and matches the REPORT contents; default output is byte-identical to before; existing tests still pass.
title: Make the CLI output machine-readable
